svg.title: LLM4Security
svg.desc: When compute is held equal, do multi-agent workflows make LLMs better hardware-security reviewers? In 4,536 pre-registered, budget-matched runs, orchestration reached 93% accuracy, a source-only agent 88%, and a tool-using agent 78%: +14.7 points, mostly from reaching a verdict.
svg.text: When compute is held equal, do multi-agent workflows
